metadata.title: Non-thermal emission in hyper-velocity and semi-relativistic stars

notes: No eligible stars. The modeled “systems” are hypothetical spectral-type/velocity/medium parameter sets rather than individually identified stars, and the paper does not explicitly establish that any star is unbound from the Milky Way (scenario definitions: T:p2-b6 and T:p3-b1). The background objects BD+43°3654 and Vela X-1 (T:p1-b10) and the unnamed ~1700 km s−1 A-type star cited from Koposov et al. (T:p1-b12) are not analyzed here as Galactic-unbound candidates; runaway/HVS labels and ejection mechanisms alone are insufficient.
